writeChain.conclusion: Canonical worker/chunk and assembler preserve consumed fields, but readiness productionIngredientPlan, promotion dry-runs, quantity-review registries, and build-recipe-overlay use explicit projections that drop them. curate-recipes itself preserves fields already present.
writeChain.recommendation: Use a separate sidecar so existing production ingredient objects, frozen artifacts, and historical promotions remain unchanged.

consumerChain.conclusion: For runtime core ingredients, qty/unit is required input for availability, missing, recommendation, and shopping. These three recipes' dual rows canonicalize to seasoning (菜油 or 豆粉), so current core/missing/recommendation/shopping ignores them; recipe display still shows input. qty/unit must not silently become actual consumed for inventory decrement. PWA accepts unknown fields on load but some projections and tests strip/forbid them; iOS safely ignores unknown fields but cannot consume them.
consumerChain.recommendation: Keep old consumers on qty/unit and make future actual-consumption features explicitly opt in to the sidecar.

designs.name: embedded-optional-consumed-fields
designs.verdict: Lossless in principle, but current writer projections and runtime-quality gates would require broad coordinated changes. Unknown-field tolerance alone is insufficient because several paths strip fields.

designs.name: independent-dual-quantity-sidecar
designs.verdict: Recommended. It preserves full source semantics without changing existing ingredient bytes or old consumers. Display remains input-only until a consumer explicitly opts in.

designs.name: permanent-source-restoration-only
designs.shape: No production representation; keep all three recipes blocked forever.
designs.verdict: Safe as the current temporary state, but not a production contract and does not complete the restoration.

Actual-consumption consumers must explicitly join by recipeId+item and define fallback behavior.

migrationPlan: Phase 0 (this review): keep all three blocked and applicationReady=false; add no production sidecar.
Phase 1: add data/recipe-quantity-semantics.json with only the three reviewed recipes and validate recipeId+item uniqueness plus input/base equality.
Phase 2: promote the three recipes through a future explicitly approved batch; write required input to the unchanged ingredient shape and consumed/raw/provenance to the sidecar atomically.
Phase 3: leave PWA/iOS old consumers unchanged; add sidecar reads only when a concrete display or actual-consumption feature is approved.
Phase 4: if duplicate ingredient names become necessary, stop and design a stable ingredient id before adding those entries; never fall back to array index.

backwardCompatibilityPlan.pwa: Existing loaders and consumers continue reading only recipe_ingredients item/qty/unit; no sidecar fetch is required.
backwardCompatibilityPlan.ios: RecipeService continues decoding item/qty/unit and does not need a model or Codable migration.
backwardCompatibilityPlan.writers: Historical readiness, promotion, quantity-review, overlay, and curated writers remain unchanged; a future promotion writes the sidecar as a separate artifact.
backwardCompatibilityPlan.frozenArtifacts: No historical promotion or production recipe artifact is rewritten.
backwardCompatibilityPlan.fallback: If sidecar is absent, old behavior is exactly unchanged; sidecar-aware actual-consumption features must surface absence instead of treating input as consumed.

Old recommendation inventory analysis is identical whether the unrelated sidecar property is present or absent.
Input and consumed quantities remain separate and exact through JSON round-trip.
All sidecar entries resolve to exactly one ingredient by recipeId+item; no array index is used.
Protected production, overlay, ledger, and readiness files equal their baseline commit bytes.

PWA/iOS actual-consumption tests before any consumer opts in.

risks: The sidecar duplicates input qty/unit for consistency proof; atomic generation and equality validation are mandatory.
recipeId+item becomes ambiguous if one recipe contains duplicate exact item strings.
A sidecar-aware consumer could accidentally fall back from missing consumed data to input and over-decrement inventory.
Old clients remain source-display-incomplete because they intentionally show input only.
Approximate consumed values must never be promoted to exact consumed.qty.
